mnemonic.meaning: 繋 has 糸 (thread): tying things together with thread.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUNAGERU!" (つなげる) Tuna geru: you link the tuna cans.

examples.ja: 二つの線を繋げた。
examples.en: I connected the two wires.

items.note: Close to 繋ぐ (つなぐ). Usually in kana: つなげる. Intransitive: 繋がる.

mnemonic.meaning: 景 view + 気 air: the air of the times. How business looks.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, KEY!" (けいき) Okay, the key to a good economy.

examples.ja: 最近、景気が良くなってきた。
examples.en: The economy has been picking up lately.

items.note: 景気がいい = business is booming. 不景気 = recession.

mnemonic.meaning: 刑 punishment + 事 matter: someone who handles criminal matters.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, JEE!" (けいじ) Okay, gee, the detective's here.

examples.ja: 刑事が犯人を追いかけた。
examples.en: The detective chased the criminal.

items.note: Also "criminal" in law: 刑事事件 (criminal case).

mnemonic.meaning: 寮 has 宀 (roof): a roof over many people.
mnemonic.reading: "RYOU!" (りょう) Ryo lives in the dorm.

examples.ja: 大学の寮に住んでいる。
examples.en: I live in the university dorm.

items.note: 社員寮 = company housing for employees.

mnemonic.meaning: 基 base: standing on a base.
mnemonic.reading: "MOTO, ZUKU!" (もとづく) Built on the base (基, もと).

examples.ja: この映画は実話に基づいている。
examples.en: This film is based on a true story.

items.note: Usually 〜に基づいて / 基づく. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 双 pair + 子 child: a pair of children.
mnemonic.reading: "FUTA, GO!" (ふたご) Two (二, ふた) kids go together.

examples.ja: あの二人は双子だ。
examples.en: Those two are twins.

items.note: 双子座 = Gemini.

mnemonic.meaning: 祭 = meat on an altar (示) held by a hand: an offering at a festival.
mnemonic.reading: "MATSURI!" (まつり) The summer festival.

examples.ja: 夏祭に浴衣で行った。
examples.en: I went to the summer festival in a yukata.

items.note: Usually written 祭り. お祭り is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 飛 fly + 行 go: going by flying.
mnemonic.reading: "HEE, KOU!" (ひこう) Hiko-ki (飛行機), the plane.

examples.ja: 飛行中は席を立たないでください。
examples.en: Please stay seated during the flight.

items.note: 飛行機 = airplane. 飛行場 = airfield.

mnemonic.meaning: 討 has 言 (words): words that strike. Attacking an enemy.
mnemonic.reading: "UTSU!" (うつ) Same sound as 打つ (hit) and 撃つ (shoot).

examples.ja: 主人公は父の敵を討った。
examples.en: The hero avenged his father.

items.note: Old-fashioned, from stories: 敵を討つ (take revenge).

mnemonic.meaning: 課 has 言 (words): assigned words. A lesson or section.
mnemonic.reading: "KA!" (か) Ka: the section chief.

examples.ja: 彼は営業課で働いている。
examples.en: He works in the sales section.

items.note: A section in a company: 課長 (section chief). Also a textbook lesson: 第三課.

mnemonic.meaning: SUTEKI: "Steak-ey!" A lovely steak dinner.

examples.ja: すてきな服ですね。
examples.en: That's a lovely outfit.

items.note: Kanji: 素敵. Often used for charming things and people.

mnemonic.meaning: 片 piece + 付 attach: putting the pieces back.
mnemonic.reading: "KATA, ZUKE!" (かたづけ) From 片付ける.

examples.ja: パーティーの後の片付けを手伝った。
examples.en: I helped clean up after the party.

items.note: 後片付け = clearing up afterwards.

mnemonic.meaning: 缶 looks like a pot with a lid.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN!" (かん) Sounds like "can".

examples.ja: 空き缶を拾った。
examples.en: I picked up the empty cans.

items.note: 缶ジュース = canned juice. 缶詰 = canned food.

mnemonic.meaning: 仕 do + 様 way: the way it's done.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, YOU!" (しよう) She shows you how. Same sound as 使用 (use).

examples.ja: この携帯の仕様を確認した。
examples.en: I checked the specs of this phone.

items.note: Tech specs. 仕様がない (しょうがない) = it can't be helped.

mnemonic.meaning: 兎 looks like a rabbit sitting with its tail out.
mnemonic.reading: "USAGI!" (うさぎ) Usagi, the rabbit (also Sailor Moon's name).

examples.ja: 庭に兎がいる。
examples.en: There's a rabbit in the garden.

items.note: Usually written ウサギ or うさぎ.

mnemonic.meaning: 転 turn + 校 school: turning to a new school.
mnemonic.reading: "TEN, KOU!" (てんこう) Ten kids go to a new school. Same sound as 天候 (weather).

examples.ja: 父の仕事で転校した。
examples.en: I changed schools because of my father's job.

items.note: 転校生 = transfer student.

mnemonic.meaning: 書 book + 斎 study room: a room for books.
mnemonic.reading: "SHO, SAI!" (しょさい) Show the size of your study.

examples.ja: 父は書斎で本を読んでいる。
examples.en: My father is reading in his study.

items.note: A private room for reading and writing at home.

mnemonic.meaning: UNARU: "Oon, aru!" The sound of a low growl.

examples.ja: 犬がうなって、こちらをにらんだ。
examples.en: The dog growled and glared at us.

items.note: Also for engines and people impressed: 観客をうならせる (impress the audience). Kanji: 唸る.

mnemonic.meaning: 羽 feather + 根 root: the root of a feather.
mnemonic.reading: "HANE!" (はね) Hane: a feather.

examples.ja: 床に鳥の羽根が落ちていた。
examples.en: There was a bird's feather on the floor.

items.note: Also blades of a fan, or a shuttlecock. Often just 羽.

mnemonic.meaning: 物 thing + 理 logic: the logic of things.
mnemonic.reading: "BUTSU, REE!" (ぶつり) Boots really obey physics.

examples.ja: 物理の試験は難しかった。
examples.en: The physics exam was hard.

items.note: 物理学 = physics. 物理的 = physical.

mnemonic.meaning: 降 surrender + 伏 bow down: bowing down in surrender.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, FUKU!" (こうふく) Same sound as 幸福 (happiness).

examples.ja: 敵は降伏した。
examples.en: The enemy surrendered.

items.note: Military or formal. Everyday: 負けを認める.

mnemonic.meaning: 治 govern: keep things in order.
mnemonic.reading: "OSAMERU!" (おさめる) Same sound as 収める, 納める (pay) and 修める (study).

examples.ja: 王は長い間その国を治めた。
examples.en: The king ruled that country for a long time.

items.note: 治める = govern or calm. 収める / 納める / 修める are other おさめる verbs.

mnemonic.meaning: 至 extreme + 急 urgent: extremely urgent.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, KYUU!" (しきゅう) She needs it ASAP. Same sound as 支給 (Level 21).

examples.ja: 至急連絡してください。
examples.en: Please contact us immediately.

items.note: Business: 大至急 = extremely urgent.

mnemonic.meaning: 進 advance + 学 study: advancing in study.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, GAKU!" (しんがく) Shin goes up a level of school.

examples.ja: 大学に進学するつもりだ。
examples.en: I plan to go on to university.

items.note: Moving up to the next level of school. 入学 = entering a school.

mnemonic.meaning: 殻 = the hard outside of something.
mnemonic.reading: "KARA!" (から) Same sound as 空 (empty): the shell is empty.

examples.ja: 卵の殻を割った。
examples.en: I cracked the egg's shell.

items.note: 殻に閉じこもる = to retreat into your shell.

mnemonic.meaning: 哲 philosophy + 学 study: the study of wisdom.
mnemonic.reading: "TETSU, GAKU!" (てつがく) Iron (鉄) studies: hard thinking.

examples.ja: 大学で哲学を勉強した。
examples.en: I studied philosophy at university.

items.note: Also a personal philosophy: 人生哲学.

mnemonic.meaning: 見 see + 舞 visit: going to see someone.
mnemonic.reading: "MI, MAI!" (みまい) Me, my visit to the hospital.

examples.ja: 入院中の友達のお見舞いに行った。
examples.en: I visited a friend in hospital.

items.note: Usually お見舞い. Also a get-well gift or card.

mnemonic.meaning: 競 compete + 技 skill: competing with skill.
mnemonic.reading: "KYOU, GI!" (きょうぎ) Same sound as 協議 (Level 18).

examples.ja: 陸上競技が好きだ。
examples.en: I like track and field events.

items.note: A sporting event or contest. 試合 = a match.

mnemonic.meaning: 食 food + 糧 provisions: food supplies.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOKU, RYOU!" (しょくりょう) Same sound as 食料 (Level 11).

examples.ja: 世界の食糧問題を考える。
examples.en: We think about the world food problem.

items.note: 食糧 = staple foods like grain, often in big-picture issues. 食料 = food in general.

mnemonic.meaning: 機 machine + 構 structure: the structure of a machine.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, KOU!" (きこう) Same sound as 気候 (climate).

examples.ja: 政府は新しい機構を作った。
examples.en: The government set up a new body.

items.note: Formal: organizations (国際機構) or mechanisms.
